g.data-exception-reason: Explicit Index alternatives sample the continuous contours near2mm pitch with1.2mm design circles. Centres closer than1.5mm are omitted at junctions. Mouse body and button boundary sampled before the split; headphone cups sampled before the band to avoid duplicate contact dots. Telephone handset, base and control remain separate. All dot alternatives remain within the same shared master. These are design positions, not measured hardware properties.

g.data-design-reason: Reuse exact continuous geometry. Telephone base/handset, mouse body and headphone cups have lower grey surfaces; boundaries higher black. Telephone control centre and headphone opening unraised white. No material or measured-height claim.
